# Legacy generated-expert delivery audit

**The retained Legacy009 profile does not automatically change the portable expert generated by its package.** The frozen baseline and exact retained development package produced byte-identical forty-two-file experts, including their complete knowledge trees. Default searches were also identical. This identifies the scope of the measured improvement; it adds no EnterpriseRAG score or evolution attempt.

## Exact generation and verification

The audit used the actual 252-file E7 baseline and the original staged Legacy candidate009. Their sole different file is `assets/retrieval-profile.json`; the retained Legacy search settings are `{"engine":"bm25","k1":2.0,"title_weight":4.0}`, with an empty construction-plan patch. The candidate archive is bound to the published terminal Legacy search. Neither generator was edited.

Both generation runs used the same twelve authored synthetic Markdown documents, manifest, reviewed guidance, expert name and physical layout. The vocabulary fixture was reused from the Turso mechanics audit; it contains no benchmark query, relevance label or business authority. The actual generator smoke, native build, independent deep validation, deterministic `--check` rebuild, generated runtime smoke, generated deep verification and skill validation passed for both packages.

Three searches per expert reproduced the complete native ledger CLI payload after removing only the expert and citation additions. Every returned citation resolved. All twelve records were then read individually from each expert: 24 exact `get` calls preserved authoritative bodies and resolved their physical evidence. All 42 files in each expert remained unchanged. Neither expert embeds the experimental retrieval-profile asset or helper.

## Three consultation contracts

| Contract | Matching and ordering |
| --- | --- |
| Generated Legacy expert, default `ledger` mode | Native `ledger --contains`: Unicode case-insensitive whole query substring in title, record ID, body or serialized attributes; preserves canonical ledger order |
| E7 Legacy empty-profile `lexical` route | Exact normalized query tokens; logarithmic term frequency times IDF; ordered by score, then concept path |
| E7 Legacy retained009 `lexical` route | In-memory BM25 over authoritative records, with `k1=2.0` and title weight `4.0`; ordered by score, then record ID |

The comparison calls the frozen E7 bridge itself with each generator and the same generated bundle. Only synthetic queries and returned record identities are compared; no retrieval metric is scored.

| Synthetic query | Generated default results | E7 baseline results | E7 retained results | Generated order equals baseline | Generated order equals retained |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | --- | --- |
| `quasar` | 10 | 9 | 9 | False | False |
| `photon` | 9 | 8 | 8 | False | False |
| `quasar photon` | 4 | 10 | 10 | False | False |

Both E7 routes differ from the generated default on all three controlled queries. For `quasar photon`, the default returns four phrase matches while both E7 routes return ten token-ranked records. These are mechanical set and order differences, not relevance judgments or predicted accuracy losses.

## Delivery consequence

The native Legacy improvement belongs to the explicit E7 consultation route and its retained profile. An exact accepted package can deliver that experimental recipe, but installing its profile alone does not make portable generated experts inherit BM25. The final family report and any installation receipt must identify the measured execution path.

Automatic expert inheritance requires a separately realized and tested integration, including exact native behavior, document identity, citations and read-only verification. That would change the package digest and is not the exact E7 candidate. This audit performs no such integration, installation, new study or promotion. It does not modify the completed Legacy development history or the live family searches.

No model, private validation, benchmark question content or relevance label was used. All original study inputs and both tested generator packages remain unchanged. The joint freeze, all-500 paired comparison and private acceptance gate remain pending.
